"That's something Shiro didn't realize before...how unkempt Keith's hair looked. It hadn't been trimmed at all recently, by the looks of it.   It was a good distraction from the jabs Keith wanted to pull.  "Where are we?" Shiro asked simply."

"Keith didn't look worried or relieved. His expression almost read as pride...something smug.  "Always ending up unconscious when you loose your prosthetic, huh? Makes you easy to take down with the right blade." Keith's head tilted, his mess of hair falling into his face."

"Keith had to be who brought him here, but why? Fuck, there were so many 'why's.   But all those questions didn't drain out the hum Shiro caught from beyond the foot of the bed, his eyes snapping to the figure sitting against the wall.  "You're awake.""

"It looked like he was chained to a bed. A really nice bed...in a really nice room. It was all Galran for sure - the drapery around the bed along with the wall decor made that much evident. Hell, it didn't even look lived in. There was nothing personal here."

"Awareness of the situation flooded back soon after, not surprised to look over and see his prosthetic was nowhere to be seen. There was no way it was functional anymore anyways.  He should be thankful he wasn't on some examination table. But that's the thing..."

"His fight or flight kicked in immediately, his head snapping over to see what was keeping his arm restrained. And fuck, it brought back horrible memories to see Galran restraints keeping his arm still."
